contentList.content: When a spell damages you, you regain a level 1 spell slot. Once per short rest.
Ranged weapon attack that deals 1d4 extra damage.
Costs your action and bonus action. Ranged weapon attack that deals 4d10 extra damage. Once per short rest.
Ranged weapon attack that deals 1d6 extra damage.
Costs your action and bonus action. Ranged weapon attack that deals 8d10 extra damage. Once per long rest.
Ranged weapon attack that deals 1d8 extra damage.
Ranged weapon attack that deals 2d6 extra damage.
Costs your action and bonus action. Ranged weapon attack that deals 2d8 extra damage.
Costs your action and bonus action. Ranged weapon attack that deals 3d8 extra damage. Once per short rest.
Enemies within 3 m of you take 4d6 cold damage and are Slowed for 2 turns (Constitution save: half damage, not slowed). Once per short rest.
Piercing damage you take is reduced by 3.
Revive a dead ally and heal it for 4d8. Once per long rest.
Enemies within 3 m of you make a Dexterity save or take 1d8 slashing damage (2d8 from level 5, 3d8 from level 11).
Hurl your fighting spirit at a creature up to 9 m away: ranged unarmed attack roll, 1d10 + your unarmed attack modifier force damage.
When you take damage, regain 1d4+2 HP. Once per turn.
Mega Flare: enemies within 5 m of a point up to 18 m away take 8d8 force damage (Dexterity save for half). Allies are spared. Once per long rest.
You can Speak with Animals at will. Always on while Orator is your job. (FFT: talk skills work on monsters; here they always do.)
A creature within 18 m gains Faith for 3 turns: +2 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC, but -2 to saving throws (strengthen an ally's magic, or soften an enemy). Once per short rest.
Enemies within 3 m of you take 3d6 psychic damage and are Silenced for 1 turn (Wisdom save: half damage, no silence; FFT drains MP). Once per short rest.
6d6 cold damage in a 4.5 m radius; Dexterity save for half. Once per long rest.
3d6 cold damage in a 3 m radius; Dexterity save for half. Once per short rest.
1d8 cold damage to a creature within 18 m, no attack roll.
When a hit leaves you at 25% of your hit points or less, you strike back: the attacker takes 4d10 slashing damage. Once per short rest.
Unarmed strikes get +1 to attack rolls and deal 1d6 more damage. Always on while Monk is your job.
You and allies within 6 m gain Reflect for 3 turns. Once per long rest.
You and allies within 3 m regain 2d6 + your unarmed attack modifier hit points and one level 1 spell slot (FFT restores MP). Once per short rest.
A ring of blue flame: enemies within 5 m of you take 8d6 fire damage (Dexterity save for half). Once per long rest.
A creature within 18 m makes a Constitution save or is Doomed: it dies when Doom runs out after 3 turns. Bosses are immune. Once per long rest.

Only in shadow or darkness. Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 bludgeoning damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Constitution save has a 1 in 10 chance of being turned to Stone for 2 turns.
A creature within 18 m makes a Constitution save or turns Undead for 3 turns: it can't regain hit points and is vulnerable to radiant damage. Once per short rest.
Reaction: when an enemy hits you with a melee attack, strike back with your weapon or fists.
When a melee attack hits you, the attacker takes 1d4 bludgeoning damage and is pushed 1.5 m.
When damage leaves you at 20% of your hit points or less, you get an extra action on your next turn. Once per short rest.
When damage leaves you at 20% of your hit points or less, you regain half your maximum hit points. Once per long rest.
When damage leaves you at 20% of your hit points or less, you regain all your level 1 spell slots. Once per long rest.
Heal up to 3 allies for 2d8+3. Once per short rest.
Heal up to 4 allies for 4d8+4. Once per long rest.
Heal a creature within 18 m for 1d8+3. Once per turn.
Spin and strike every enemy within 2 m: an unarmed attack roll against each, 1d8 + your unarmed attack modifier bludgeoning on a hit. FFT also hits allies; here only enemies.
Enemies within 5 m of a point up to 18 m away take 7d10 bludgeoning damage (Dexterity save for half). Allies are spared. Once per long rest.
8d10 necrotic damage to a creature within 18 m; Constitution save for half. Undead and constructs cannot be targeted. Once per long rest.
A foe within 9 m makes a Wisdom save or hands over gold: 10 times its level (once per creature, shared with Steal Gil).
A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or is Confused for 2 turns (it repeats the save each turn). Once per short rest.
A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or becomes an Atheist for 2 turns: it can't cast spells and has advantage on saving throws against spells. Once per short rest.

Unarmed strike at a pressure point: on a hit, the creature makes a Constitution save (your Strength/Dexterity DC) or is Doomed, and dies when Doom runs out after 3 turns. Bosses are immune. Once per long rest.
+2 damage with versatile weapons (longswords, spears, quarterstaffs, ...) held in both hands.
When a weapon attack damages you, you gain Death Ward (the next blow that would drop you to 0 HP leaves you at 1 instead; FFT gives Reraise). Once per long rest.
Advantage on Wisdom saving throws (most talk skills and charms aim at Wisdom).
Fully heal the target and restore one level 2 spell slot. Once per long rest. Thrown like Potion.
Drain a creature within 18 m: it makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d10 psychic damage, and you regain a level 1 spell slot (FFT absorbs MP). Once per short rest.
A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or becomes an Atheist for 2 turns: no spells, advantage on saving throws against spells.
A foe within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or switches sides for 2 turns (4 with Tame), fighting for you on its own. Bosses are immune. Once per short rest.
Proficiency with handaxes, battleaxes and greataxes.
Proficiency with hand, light and heavy crossbows.
Proficiency with hand crossbows and light crossbows (BG3 has no guns), whatever your job.
Proficiency with medium and heavy armour.
Proficiency with longswords and scimitars (BG3 has no katanas), whatever your job.
Proficiency with spears, pikes, glaives, halberds and tridents, whatever your job.
Proficiency with shortswords, longswords and greatswords.
End Poisoned, Blinded, Silenced and Frightened on a creature within 18 m. Once per turn.
The target regains one level 1 spell slot. Once per long rest. Thrown like Potion.
Adds the Defend bonus action: +2 AC until your next turn.
Up to 6 allies within 18 m regain 4d8 hit points. Once per short rest.
A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or goes Berserk for 2 turns: it can't cast spells, deals 2 more damage and has -2 AC. Once per short rest.
3d6 fire damage in a 3 m radius; Dexterity save for half. Once per short rest.
6d6 fire damage in a 4.5 m radius; Dexterity save for half. Once per long rest.
1d8 fire damage to a creature within 18 m, no attack roll.
Reaction: when an enemy moves into your melee reach, attack it first (like Polearm Master, with any weapon or fists). BG3 cannot cancel the enemy's own attack.
10d10 force damage to a creature within 18 m, no attack roll. Once per long rest.
An ally within 18 m floats for 3 turns: it can't be knocked prone and ignores difficult terrain.
Bonus action. +1 to attack rolls and +1 damage for 10 turns.
When you take damage, you gain that much gold.
You and allies within 6 m gain 15 temporary hit points (FFT's Golem blocks physical damage). Once per long rest.
Creatures within 3 m of a point up to 18 m away make a Constitution save or lose half of their maximum hit points (force). Bosses are immune. Once per long rest.
Creatures within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away make a Constitution save or lose a quarter of their maximum hit points (force). Bosses are immune. Once per short rest.
When you finish a short rest, you regain one level 1 and one level 2 spell slot (FFT halves MP costs).

Strip a creature within 18 m of its blessings: Haste, Bless, Aid, Heroism, Shield of Faith, Barkskin, Stoneskin, Blur, Protection from Evil and Good, Freedom of Movement, Sanctuary, Longstrider, Invisibility, and this mod's Protect, Shell, Regen, Focus, Faith, Reflect, Float and Quick. Once per short rest.
An ally within 18 m is Hasted for 3 turns (BG3's Haste: an extra action, +2 AC, more movement, then a turn of lethargy). No concentration. Once per short rest.
Every ally within 4 m of a point up to 18 m away is Hasted for 3 turns (as Haste). Once per long rest.
A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or is Disabled for 1 turn: no actions or bonus actions (it can still move).
Heal 4d4+4. Once per short rest. Thrown like Potion.
4d10 radiant damage to a creature within 18 m, no attack roll. Once per short rest.

Jump: leap up to 6 m (action, once per turn) and land on the enemies around that spot: each makes a Dexterity save (your Strength/Dexterity DC) or takes your weapon's damage and falls prone (half damage on a save). Only your best Horizontal Jump counts.

Jump: leap up to 7.5 m (action, once per turn) and land on the enemies around that spot: each makes a Dexterity save (your Strength/Dexterity DC) or takes your weapon's damage and falls prone (half damage on a save). Only your best Horizontal Jump counts.

Jump: leap up to 9 m (action, once per turn) and land on the enemies around that spot: each makes a Dexterity save (your Strength/Dexterity DC) or takes your weapon's damage and falls prone (half damage on a save). Only your best Horizontal Jump counts.

Jump: leap up to 12 m (action, once per turn) and land on the enemies around that spot: each makes a Dexterity save (your Strength/Dexterity DC) or takes your weapon's damage and falls prone (half damage on a save). Only your best Horizontal Jump counts.

Jump: leap up to 18 m (action, once per turn) and land on the enemies around that spot: each makes a Dexterity save (your Strength/Dexterity DC) or takes your weapon's damage and falls prone (half damage on a save). Only your best Horizontal Jump counts.
Enemies within 3 m of a point up to 18 m away take 4d6 fire damage (Dexterity save for half). Allies are spared. Once per short rest.
Jump 6 m farther and take no falling damage.
Difficult terrain (water, mud, ice, vines, ...) doesn't slow you.
You ignore difficult terrain (mud, water, ice, webs).
An enemy within 18 m makes a Strength save or can't move for 2 turns (it can still act; it repeats the save each turn).
A creature within 18 m makes a Constitution save or is Petrified for 2 turns (incapacitated, resistant to all damage). Bosses are immune. Once per long rest.
A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or goes Berserk for 2 turns: no spells, 2 more damage, -2 AC. Once per short rest.
A foe within 18 m makes a Charisma save or is Baned for 3 turns (-1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws; FFT lowers Bravery).
Ranged spell attack against a creature within 18 m: 3d6 necrotic damage, and you regain half the damage dealt. Once per short rest.
Enemies in a 12 m line from you take 6d8 slashing damage (Dexterity save for half). Once per long rest.
You and allies within 3 m of you gain Protect (+2 AC) and Shell (advantage on saves against spells) for 3 turns. Once per short rest.
Enemies within 3 m of you take 3d6 necrotic damage (Constitution save for half). Once per short rest.
Walk on lava: it doesn't set you ablaze or slow you.

A tidal wave: enemies within 5 m of a point up to 18 m away take 5d8 bludgeoning damage and are soaked (Wet: weak to cold and lightning; Dexterity save for half, not wet). Allies are spared. Once per long rest.
You always float: you can't be knocked prone and you ignore difficult terrain.
Enemies within 4 m of a point up to 18 m away take 4d10 necrotic damage (Constitution save for half). Allies are spared. Once per long rest.
When you move, regain 1d6 hit points. Once per turn.
+1 spell save DC and +1 to spell attack rolls.
When a spell damages you, its caster takes 2d6 force damage.

Only while you stand in fire or lava. Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 fire damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Dexterity save has a 1 in 10 chance of being struck down at the end of its next turn (Doom 1; bosses are immune).
Reaction: when you would take damage, spend a level 1 spell slot to reduce it by 3d8 (FFT takes the damage from MP).
When you move, you regain a level 1 spell slot. Once per short rest.
You and allies within 3 m of you gain Regen for 3 turns and Haste for 2 (an extra action, +2 AC, double movement; lethargic for a turn afterwards, as in BG3). Once per long rest.
A meteor smashes into a point up to 18 m away: creatures within 5 m take 5d8 bludgeoning and 5d8 fire damage (Dexterity save for half). Once per long rest.
A dull lecture: enemies within 3 m of a point up to 18 m away make a Wisdom save or fall Asleep for 2 turns (they wake when damaged). Allies are spared. Once per short rest.
Up to 4 allies within 18 m regain 2d8 hit points. Once per short rest.

Enemies within 3 m of you take 4d8 necrotic damage. On a failed Wisdom save they are Confused for 2 turns, with a 1 in 10 chance of Doom (bosses are immune); on a success they take half. Once per long rest.
You and allies within 3 m of you regain 2d8 hit points. Once per short rest.
When a weapon attack hits you, the ground strikes back: the attacker takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11). Once per turn.
Zantetsuken: enemies within 4 m of a point up to 18 m away take 6d10 slashing damage (Constitution save for half; FFT kills outright). Allies are spared. Once per long rest.
Slashing, piercing and bludgeoning damage you take is reduced by 2.
Revive a dead ally with 1 HP. Once per short rest. Thrown like Potion.
When a beast or monster (not a humanoid) you hit with a weapon this turn dies, you take a trophy worth 5 times its level in gold.
1d6 poison damage to a creature within 18 m; it is Poisoned for 2 turns unless it succeeds a Constitution save.
Heal 2d4+2. Touch range, or 9 m when thrown (Chemist primary job or Throw Items).
An ally within 18 m is Blessed for 3 turns (+1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws; FFT raises Bravery).
A creature within 18 m gains Faith for 3 turns: +2 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC, -2 to saving throws.
The target gets +2 AC for 5 turns. Once per turn.
Two quick unarmed strikes at a creature in melee range: each hit deals 1d6 + your unarmed attack modifier bludgeoning.
You and allies within 3 m are cured of blindness, poison, disease, paralysis, silence, sleep, confusion, fear and charm. Once per short rest.
Another ally within 18 m gets an extra action on its next turn (BG3 cannot give it a turn right away). Once per long rest.

Only while you stand in mud, blood, acid or poison. Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 bludgeoning damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Strength save has a 1 in 10 chance of being Doomed (dies after 3 turns; bosses are immune).
A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or is Silenced for 2 turns (no spells with a verbal component). Once per short rest.
Revive a dead ally with 1 HP. Once per short rest.
Enemies within 3 m of a point up to 18 m away take 4d6 lightning damage (Dexterity save for half). Allies are spared. Once per short rest.
An ally within 18 m is shielded for 3 turns: it takes half damage from spells, and a caster whose spell damages it takes 2d6 force damage. BG3 cannot bounce the spell itself. Once per short rest.
The target regains 1d4+1 HP at the start of each of its turns for 5 turns. Once per turn.
When you take damage, you gain Regen for 3 turns (1d4+1 HP per turn) unless you already have it.
End Poisoned, Blinded, Silenced and Frightened. Once per short rest. Thrown like Potion.
Melee weapon attack that deals no damage; on a hit the target has -2 AC for 3 turns.
Melee weapon attack that deals no damage; on a hit the target has -2 spell save DC and -2 to spell attack rolls for 3 turns.
Melee weapon attack that deals no damage; on a hit the target deals 2 less damage for 3 turns.
Melee weapon attack that deals no damage; on a hit the target has -3 m movement for 3 turns.
Melee weapon attack that deals no damage; on a hit the target has disadvantage on attack rolls for 2 turns.
A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or falls Asleep for 2 turns (it wakes when damaged). Once per short rest.
Death Ward: the next time the ally would drop to 0 HP, it drops to 1 HP instead. Once per long rest.
With a battle cry, bring a dead ally in melee range back to life with 2d8 hit points. Once per short rest.
Melee weapon attack that also pushes the target 2 m.
Enemies within 5 m of a point up to 18 m away take 6d8 fire damage (Dexterity save for half). Allies are spared. Once per long rest.
Touch an ally to end Blinded, Poisoned and Silenced.

Only in sunlight. Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 slashing damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Constitution save has a 1 in 4 chance of being Blinded for 2 turns.
The target has advantage on saving throws against spells for 5 turns. Once per turn.
When an attack hits you, use your reaction to take half damage (like Uncanny Dodge; switch it on or off on your passives bar).
Enemies within 3 m of a point up to 18 m away take 4d6 cold damage (Dexterity save for half). Allies are spared. Once per short rest.

A shockwave tears through the ground in a 12 m line: creatures in it make a Dexterity save (your Strength/Dexterity DC), taking 3d8 bludgeoning and falling prone on a failure, half damage on a success. Once per short rest.

Only on plain ground (no surface under you). Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 bludgeoning damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Dexterity save has a 1 in 4 chance of being Immobilized for 2 turns.
An enemy within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or is Slowed for 3 turns (BG3's Slow: -2 AC and Dexterity saves, half movement, no reactions; it repeats the save each turn). Once per short rest.
Every enemy within 4 m of a point up to 18 m away makes a Wisdom save or is Slowed for 3 turns (as Slow). Once per long rest.

Only while you stand on ice. Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 cold damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Constitution save has a 1 in 4 chance of being Silenced for 2 turns.
When you take damage, gain +3 m movement for 2 turns.
A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or loses its actions and bonus actions next turn (it can still move; FFT resets its CT). Once per short rest.
Melee attack roll; on a hit you take one of the enemy's accessories (amulet, ring, cloak, gloves or boots) into your inventory. Quest and story items can't be stolen.
Melee attack roll; on a hit you take the enemy's body armour into your inventory. Quest and story items can't be stolen. Once per short rest.
Melee attack roll; on a hit you gain experience: 10 times the creature's level (BG3 creatures don't lose any). Each creature can be robbed of experience once.
Melee attack roll; on a hit you pocket gold: 10 times the creature's level. Each creature can be robbed of gold once.
A creature up to 9 m away makes a Wisdom save (your Strength/Dexterity DC) or is Charmed for 2 turns: it can't harm you. Once per short rest.
Melee attack roll; on a hit you take the enemy's headwear into your inventory. Quest and story items can't be stolen.
Melee attack roll; on a hit you take the enemy's shield into your inventory. Quest and story items can't be stolen.
Melee attack roll; on a hit you take the enemy's main weapon (melee first, otherwise ranged) into your inventory. Quest and story items can't be stolen. Once per short rest.
Thrown weapons and objects deal no damage to you: you catch them (the caught item is not kept).
An enemy within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or is Stopped for 2 turns: it can't move or act, and melee hits on it are critical (it repeats the save each turn). Bosses are immune. Once per short rest.
+2 to initiative, and in each fight the first spell you cast that costs an action costs a bonus action instead (FFT casts faster).
Enemies within 3 m of a point up to 18 m away take 3d6 thunder damage and are Silenced for 2 turns (Constitution save for half, no silence). Allies are spared. Once per short rest.

Gives the Tame action: a beast or monster (not a humanoid) at 25% of its hit points or less makes a Wisdom save or fights for you for the rest of the fight. Bosses are immune. Once per short rest. Entice also lasts 4 turns.

Only while you stand in vines, overgrowth or webs. Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 piercing damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Dexterity save has a 1 in 10 chance of being Stopped for 2 turns.
Bonus action, once per turn: teleport to a spot you can see up to 9 m away (Misty Step without a spell slot).
Item abilities can be thrown up to 9 m with any job.
Throw a stone at a target up to 18 m away: 1d6 bludgeoning and a 1 m push.
6d6 lightning damage in a 4.5 m radius; Dexterity save for half. Once per long rest.
3d6 lightning damage in a 3 m radius; Dexterity save for half. Once per short rest.
1d8 lightning damage to a creature within 18 m, no attack roll.
Enemies within 3 m of a point up to 18 m away take 4d6 bludgeoning damage and fall prone (Dexterity save for half, no prone). Allies are spared. Once per short rest.

Only while you stand in water or are Wet (rain counts). Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 bludgeoning damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11) and are Wet; it can't be dodged. One that fails a Strength save has a 1 in 4 chance of being turned into a critter for 1 turn (Toad; in BG3 a sheep).
+2 to Perception (spot hidden items and traps).

Only on plain ground (no surface under you). Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 bludgeoning damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Dexterity save has a 1 in 4 chance of being Confused for 2 turns.
A creature within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened of you for 2 turns (FFT lowers Bravery).
A creature within 18 m makes a Constitution save or is Blinded for 2 turns (it repeats the save each turn).
Your Jump lands harder: 1d4 extra piercing damage to each enemy it hits (BG3 has no tile heights to reach, so the height becomes force). Only your best Vertical Jump counts.
Your Jump lands harder: 1d6 extra piercing damage to each enemy it hits (BG3 has no tile heights to reach, so the height becomes force). Only your best Vertical Jump counts.
Your Jump lands harder: 1d8 extra piercing damage to each enemy it hits (BG3 has no tile heights to reach, so the height becomes force). Only your best Vertical Jump counts.
Your Jump lands harder: 1d10 extra piercing damage to each enemy it hits (BG3 has no tile heights to reach, so the height becomes force). Only your best Vertical Jump counts.
Your Jump lands harder: 2d6 extra piercing damage to each enemy it hits (BG3 has no tile heights to reach, so the height becomes force). Only your best Vertical Jump counts.
Your Jump lands harder: 2d8 extra piercing damage to each enemy it hits (BG3 has no tile heights to reach, so the height becomes force). Only your best Vertical Jump counts.
Your Jump lands harder: 2d10 extra piercing damage to each enemy it hits (BG3 has no tile heights to reach, so the height becomes force). Only your best Vertical Jump counts.
When a weapon attack damages you, you take the Defending stance: +2 AC until your next turn. Once per turn.

Only in shadow or darkness, or while you stand in grease, oil or alcohol. Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 fire damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Wisdom save has a 1 in 4 chance of falling Asleep for 2 turns.

Only in sunlight. Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 thunder damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Strength save has a 1 in 4 chance of being Slowed for 2 turns.

Only in sunlight. Enemies within 2 m of a point up to 18 m away take 1d6 slashing damage (2d6 from level 5, 3d6 from level 11); it can't be dodged. One that fails a Dexterity save has a 1 in 4 chance of being Disabled (no actions) for 1 turn.
Heal 8d4+8. Once per long rest. Thrown like Potion.
+1 to ranged weapon attack rolls. Earned by mastering Archer; kept after changing jobs.
Charged ranged shots. Equipment: shortbows, longbows, hand crossbows, light crossbows, heavy crossbows, light armour (proficiency while this is your job). Current FFT job. Change it on the Job Board.
+1 to spell attack rolls. Earned by mastering Black Mage; kept after changing jobs.
Elemental attack magic. Equipment: quarterstaffs, clubs, light armour (proficiency while this is your job). Current FFT job. Change it on the Job Board.
Resistant to poison damage. Earned by mastering Chemist; kept after changing jobs.
Item expert. Starting job. Throws items when it is the primary job. Equipment: daggers, hand crossbows, light armour (proficiency while this is your job). Current FFT job. Change it on the Job Board.
Jump 3 m farther. Earned by mastering Dragoon; kept after changing jobs.

Leaps on enemies with a polearm: Jump's reach and landing power grow with Horizontal and Vertical Jump. Equipment: spears, pikes, glaives, halberds, tridents, shields, light armour, medium armour, heavy armour (proficiency while this is your job). Current FFT job. Change it on the Job Board.
+1 to Strength and Constitution saving throws. Earned by mastering Geomancer; kept after changing jobs.

Turns the ground under your feet into a weapon: each Geomancy skill works only on its own terrain (plain ground, sunlight, shadow, water, ice, fire, mud, vines, grease). Equipment: shortswords, longswords, handaxes, battleaxes, shields, light armour (proficiency while this is your job). Current FFT job. Change it on the Job Board.
+1 to Constitution saving throws. Earned by mastering Knight; kept after changing jobs.

Breaks the enemy's armor, weapon, speed and power. Equipment: shortswords, longswords, greatswords, light armour, medium armour, heavy armour, shields (proficiency while this is your job). Current FFT job. Change it on the Job Board.
Unarmed strikes deal 1d4 more damage. Earned by mastering Monk; kept after changing jobs.
Fights with bare fists (Brawler is always on); martial arts, healing and revival. Equipment: light armour (proficiency while this is your job). Current FFT job. Change it on the Job Board.
+1 to your spell save DC. Earned by mastering Mystic; kept after changing jobs.

Afflicts mind and body: blindness, silence, sleep, confusion, stone, drains. Equipment: quarterstaffs, clubs, light armour (proficiency while this is your job). Current FFT job. Change it on the Job Board.
+2 to Persuasion, Deception and Intimidation checks. Earned by mastering Orator; kept after changing jobs.

Talks foes into switching sides, sleeping, raging or dying; Beast Tongue is always on. Equipment: daggers, hand crossbows, light armour (proficiency while this is your job). Current FFT job. Change it on the Job Board.
You can't be Frightened. Earned by mastering Samurai; kept after changing jobs.

Draws out the spirits of legendary blades (Iaido): bursts around you that cut down enemies or shield your allies. Equipment: longswords, scimitars, light armour, medium armour, heavy armour (proficiency while this is your job). Current FFT job. Change it on the Job Board.
+5 maximum hit points. Earned by mastering Squire; kept after changing jobs.
Basic fighter. Starting job. Equipment: daggers, shortswords, longswords, handaxes, battleaxes, flails, light armour (proficiency while this is your job). Current FFT job. Change it on the Job Board.
+1 to Intelligence and Charisma saving throws. Earned by mastering Summoner; kept after changing jobs.

Calls espers: huge area magic that spares allies, healing and protection. Equipment: quarterstaffs, clubs, light armour (proficiency while this is your job). Current FFT job. Change it on the Job Board.
+2 to initiative. Earned by mastering Thief; kept after changing jobs.
Steals gold, experience, hearts and the gear off an enemy's back. Equipment: daggers, light armour (proficiency while this is your job). Current FFT job. Change it on the Job Board.
+1.5 m movement. Earned by mastering Time Mage; kept after changing jobs.
Bends time and space: Haste, Slow, Stop, Gravity and Meteor. Equipment: quarterstaffs, light armour (proficiency while this is your job). Current FFT job. Change it on the Job Board.
+1 to Wisdom saving throws. Earned by mastering White Mage; kept after changing jobs.
Healing, revival and protection. Equipment: quarterstaffs, light armour (proficiency while this is your job). Current FFT job. Change it on the Job Board.
Open the FFT Job Board: change jobs, learn abilities and set your secondary, reaction, support and movement slots. Free; does not use your turn.

Testing tool: every party member gets JP (1,000 by default) in each job they have unlocked, so you can try the jobs without grinding. Jobs it unlocks get JP from the next cast. Free; does not use your turn.
Can't cast spells; advantage on saving throws against spells.
Can't cast spells; deals 2 more damage; -2 AC.
Can't take actions or bonus actions, but can move.
Talked into switching sides: fights for the Orator's party on its own until this runs out.
+2 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC, -2 to saving throws.
